en: Changed mods' own tool calls (`$.tool.call`, `$.mcp.call`) to raise no permission prompt, even under your own ask rules or in `dontAsk` and `-p` runs; deny rules and organization policy still apply
zh: 变更 mod 自身的工具调用（`$.tool.call`、`$.mcp.call`）：不再触发权限提示，即使在你自己的 ask 规则下、在 `dontAsk` 和 `-p` 运行中也是如此；deny 规则和组织策略仍然生效
